description: Get a company's supply chain: the customers, suppliers, competitors and partners named in annual 10-K reports, its own and those of other listed companies that name it, with any stated revenue or receivables share, a revenue share in dollars from the same filing, the verbatim sentence and the source filing. A share belongs to the filing that states it. Names the filings never state are not inferred, so a missing company is not evidence of no relationship. Requires the Pro plan.

lens.description: Order within each side: 'stated' (largest stated share first, the default), 'dependsOn' (largest share of this company's revenue first: who it relies on) or 'dependents' (largest share of the other company's own revenue first: who relies on it). A share is stated by a filing or derived from a stated share in dollars.

maxResults.description: Maximum companies listed per side (customers, suppliers, competitors, partners) (default: 50, max: 500).

quantifiedOnly.description: Only companies with a stated revenue or receivables share (default: false).

side.description: Only one side: customers, suppliers, competitors or partners (default: all four).

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, QRVO), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XBRU:BAR) for a listing outside the US.

name: GetSupplyChain
title: Supply Chain
